verdict.rationale: Numeral's own marketing claims it registers, files and remits 'across US and global jurisdictions', monitors exposure in 'all US and global jurisdictions', and validates customer VAT IDs live, so it does claim a global VAT/GST capability. Beyond that, the docs and API evidence are US sales-tax framed (states, nexus, exemption certificates), and no named non-US regime is documented. missing for 10: explicit EU OSS/IOSS support, UK VAT, Canada GST/HST, Australia GST coverage, documented foreign registration-threshold tracking, documented non-US filing workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder selling internationally, VAT and GST are covered like US sales tax — EU OSS/IOSS, UK, Canada, Australia and beyond, with foreign registration thresholds tracked and filings supported

citations.quote: Register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions, on time, every time.
Continually monitor your business’s exposure in all US and global jurisdictions to identify where you have tax liability.
